from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company as stated in the document")
    report_period_end: str | None = Field(description="The specific date of the report (e.g., '2025-03-31')")
    total_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported total assets numerical value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, typically RMB for Chinese filings")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all financial records extracted from the document collection."""
    financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
